headline: Ansar Allah ballistic missile intercepted over Najran
dek: Coalition: a Ansar Allah ballistic missile launched toward the Najran region was intercepted and destroyed. Saudi Civil Defense had issued an early warning over a potential hostile threat in the Najran area, then said the danger had passed.
sources: Saudi-led coalition spokesman Maj Gen Turki al-Malki (X post); Saudi Civil Defense (threat warning, then lifted)
fault_line: Intercept = shield or sign of a war Riyadh can't stop? Fresh breaking-graphic posts (Emirates Today, Roya News, Arab News) are moving fast; the Oct-20 Riyadh missile thread ran 1.4K likes/120 comments with Filipino expat
